Commentary.Commentary: Right then! A low score but if Pakistan bowl smartly, they can take this game till the deep. They need a couple of quick wickets to put pressure on New Zealand. Stay tuned for the chase.

Michael Bracewell is up for a chat. He says the boundaries are long but they are enjoying bowling here. Adds the ball is holding a bit and there is extra bounce as well. Tells that they have all basis covered and they try to play according to the conditions. Admits they would have taken this score any day.

Pakistan were off to a good start but once Mohammad Rizwan fell, the doors opened and wickets started to tumble. No one stayed for a long time as everyone struggled. It was due to the stand between Iftikhar Ahmed and Asif Ali that Pakistan have a score above 100 and the bowlers have something to bowl now.

This is an excellent bowling performance from New Zealand. The pitch was sluggish to bat on and after the first couple of overs, The Kiwis introduced the spinners. Since then, there were right on top. Ish Sodhi, Michael Bracewell and Mitchell Santner combined to take 5 wickets. They allowed a stand to build late in the game but that too didn't trouble the score much. Tim Southee took two in the final over to keep the momentum with the team. Smart bowling from New Zealand and they have a chance to take the revenge against Pakistan.
Yes, he can! Superb from Southee! This is full and on middle, it is hit to long on for a single. Pakistan end with 130/7.
A length ball, outside off, slower one. Ali swings wildly and misses. Can Tim Southee finish on a high?
On a length and on middle. Wasim mistimes his punch to long on for a single.
Right on the money! Very full and on middle. Wasim blocks it out.
Mohammad Wasim to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tim Southee is on a Hat-trick! Excellent bowling! On a length and on middle. It is there to be hit. Nawaz swings his bat but fails to power much and Martin Guptill (sub) at deep square leg runs in and takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Martin Guptill b Tim Southee

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! CAUGHT! Tim Southee sees Iftikhar Ahmed shuffling across and anticipates Ahmed will play the paddle scoop. Southee serves it wide of off. Ahmed still goes wth the shot but ends up miscuing it to short third man where Blair Tickner takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Blair Tickner b Tim Southee

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed mistimes his pull to long on for a single.
FOUR! The stand crosses the 50-mark now! Length ball, way outside off. Ahmed uses the width and slaps it to point for four runs
A slower length ball, outside off. Ahmed slashes and misses.
FOUR! much needed! Length and on the pads. Ahmed whacks it. Michael Bracewell was standing at deep square leg but had to back paddle, the ball evades him and bounces before reaching the ropes.
Short of a length and outside off. Ahmed looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to the keeper. Collected on a bounce.
Wide! Follows Ahmed down the leg side, but this is way to down. Wided.
Full ball and on middle. Ali flicks on the up and to deep square leg for a single.
Good over from Southee! This is full and outside off. Ali eases it to long off for a single. 7 runs off it.
Another good ball from Southee! Very full and on off. Ahmed works it to long off for one.
Tim keeps it full. Ali hits it hard but to long on. The batters cross.
Wide! A length ball, way outside off. Ali leaves it.
Pace-off from Southee, full and on off. Ali fails to hit it cleanly.
Full again. Ahmed thumps it back and hits the stumps at the non-striker's end. A single as it rolls to mid-wicket. That was hit very hard.
Very full and around off. Ahmed whips it to long on for a couple of runs.
On middle, this one stays low, flicked to deep square leg for a single. Once again the spinner dries things up. Upto the seamers to finish on a high now.
Wide! This is on a length and down the leg side. Ahmed misses his sweep and once again Devon Conway collects and appeals. No reviews left for New Zealand this time.
Follows Ali on the leg side, this is hit to long on for one more.
Slower one on middle. Ali plays it back to the bowler..
This one comes with the angle, Ahmed looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads and it rolls to point for a single.
Another single as Ali drills it to long on.
Flatter and on middle. Ahmed works it to long on for a single.
On middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single. 13 off the over, 24 off the last two.
A full toss. Ali flicks and Sodhi misfields and lets it through at square leg for a single. Ali wants one more but no communication between the batters.
FOUR! Well played! Length and on middle. Ali helps it away behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Short of a length and outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for easy couple.
Wide! Full and down the leg side, Ali misses his flick.
FOUR! Boundaries flowing now in the last couple of overs. Not off the middle this one. This is outside off. Ali cuts, gets an outside edge and it goes to third man for four.
Superb fielding by Santner! Length and outside off. Ali guides it to the left of point where Mitchell Santner makes an excellent stop.
Tim Southee is back on.
FOUR! Two boundaries off the part-timer! Flatter, slower and width there. Ahmed slaps it through covers for four.
On the pads, helped to short fine leg for a single.
Around off, Ahmed plays it with the spin to mid-wicket. Glenn Phillips makes a good stop running across.
Slower ball, length and outside off. Ahmed punches it to point.
Full and outside off, drilled down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Much needed one! Flatter ball, outside off. Ali opens the face of the bat and guides it past backward point for a boundary.
Glenn Phillips to bowl now. More spin...
Tossed up again, outside off. Ali chips it to long off for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Ali defends it to cover.
Floated, full and outside off. Ahmed knocks it to deep cover for a single.
Flatter and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Asif Ali walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ish Sodhi gets into the wickets column now! What a game the spinners are having. This is very full and on middle. Ali tries to break the shackles as he tries to get underneath but fails and ends up hitting it straight to Tim Southee at long on.
Commentary.Howout: c Tim Southee b Ish Sodhi

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up on middle. Ali goes inside-out over covers for a couple of runs.
Short and outside off. Ahmed cuts it straight to point. An incredible spell from Michael Bracewell, 4-0-11-2.
Flatter ball, outside off. Ahmed punches it to cover.
On off, kept out.
Another single as this is hit to long on.
Short ball on middle. Ahmed pulls to square leg for a single. Good fielding.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Ahmed eases it to mid-wicket.
Too short and on middle. Ali pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Outside off again, Ali works it through point for a couple of runs.
Outside off, cut to point.
On middle, tucked away to square leg.

Devon Conway is confident as he pouches this ball down the leg side and puts on a big appeal. Kane Williamson believes him and takes it upstairs. Slow motion doesn't show much. Ultra Edge does show a spike but the third umpire feels it is not off the bat. There was a bit of gap. EVEN ALI WAS WALKING OFF. This looks a bit controversial. Not a wicket taking delivery. This is short and down the leg side. Ali looks to pull but seems to miss it. Devon Conway collects it. An appeal and nothing given. The replay shows there was a spike as the ball passes the bottom edge but the third umpire doesn't think so. A big talking point in this game.
Flatter and on middle. Ahmed flicks it to square leg for one.
Ish Sodhi is back on.

Two runs and a wicket off this over! This is so good from New Zealand and they are bossing the game right now! Tossed up, outside off, turning in. Ali looks to drive but gets an outside edge to short third man.
A single as Ahmed drills it to long on.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
On middle. Blocked out.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The big fish goes now and the spinners are doing a really good job for the Kiwi. Azam tried to anchor the innings but edges one here. Superb from Michael Bracewell! He serves it slow and outside off, flatter, and a hint of turn. Azam looks to punch but gets a faint outside edge and Devon Conway doesn't make any mistake. New Zealand all over Pakistan here.
Commentary.Howout: c Devon Conway b Michael Bracewell

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, punched straight to cover.
Slants a full ball on middle. Ahmed keeps it out. Brilliant over from Santner. He has grown in this game.
This one comes with the angle, length and angling on the pads. Ahmed misses his flick. A muted appeal follows.
Wide! Mitchell Santner again serves it down the leg side. Ahmed misses his flick.
Flat ball, outside off, quicker. Azam slaps it to deep point for a single.
On middle, pulled straight to square leg.
An arm ball, sliding down. Ahmed pulls it to short fine leg for a single.
Iftikhar Ahmed comes in.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust and Mitchell Santner gets his second! Shadab Khan hits this without much conviction. This is full, quicker and outside off. Khan drags it but finds Tim Southee at long on who takes a simple catch. Khan gifts his wicket here and fails to make an impact.
Commentary.Howout: c Tim Southee b Mitchell Santner

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and on middle. Azam keeps it out.
This is full and on middle, turning away. Khan makes room and an inside edge saves him from getting bowled. It rolls to square leg for one.
Shorter and on middle. Khan punches it to mid on and takes a brace. Good running.

Flatter and around off, it was the googly. Khan waits on the back foot as he looks to cut but misses. A huge appeal for LBW but the umpire doesn't move. Devon Conway reckons it is outside the line but Kane Williamson still goes for the review. Ultra Edge shows it is pad first. Ball Tracking shows impact is outside the line and wickets are missing.
FOUR! Very full and outside off. Khan spanks it through covers for a boundary.
This one is the googly, on the pads. Khan misses his flick.
Tossed up on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for one.
Shadab Khan walks in.

OUT! TAKEN! Masood goes and Mitchell Santner strikes against the run of play! Santner slows it up, fuller and outside off. Masood advances down the track as he looks to go downtown but fails to get the required distance. Michael Bracewell at long on takes a simple catch. This will help Mitchell Santner so much.
Commentary.Howout: c Michael Bracewell b Mitchell Santner

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball, outside off. Azam drills it to point for a single.
On middle, Shan works it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Santner has not been good so far! Flatter and outside off. Masood makes room and punches it wide of long off for four runs.
Short and outside off, reverse swept to short third man.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to covers.
A single as this is hit to mid-wicket.

PUT DOWN! Hard chance though! This is full and on middle, flighted. Masood makes room as he tries to go inside-out. He hits it to deep cover. Mark Chapman from long off covers a lot of ground and dives forward but the ball just falls in front of him. Two runs.
Very full and outside off. Azam squeezes it out on the off side to point for a quick single.
On middle, a googly. Masood works it to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, driven through covers for one.
Ish Sodhi to bowl now.
A slower one to finish the over, this is outside off. Masood misses his drive. At the end of the Powerplay, New Zealand have done well to pull Pakistan back. They are 42/1.
FOUR! Helped away! Short of a length and on middle. Masood pulls, it goes off the gloves and over short fine leg for four.
Outside off, guided to point.
Short in length and on middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Wrong line! This is full and on the pads. Azam shows his wrists work as he works it to square leg for four.
Wide!Tickner misses his line and serves it down the leg side for a wide.
Extra pace and bounce! Length ball, outside off at 139 clicks. Azam slashes and misses.
This is wide of off. Masood knocks it to covers.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket for one more.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to covers.
A single as Masood drives it to long off.
Shan Masood is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Rizwan goes and he instantly knew after hitting it that it was not off the middle! Michael Bracewell was troubling Rizwan there and he looked frustrated. This is full and outside off, again slower in the air. Rizwan comes down the track to heave but it goes off the top edge and high in the air. James Neesham at mid on takes the skier, back paddling.
Commentary.Howout: c James Neesham b Michael Bracewell

Commentary.Commentary: This one turns away, full and outside off. Rizwan is beaten on the outside edge as he looks to drive.
Another tidy over from New Zealand! Short in length and on off. Azam dabs it to point.
Full again, on off, this sticks in the surface. Rizwan ends up chipping it to mid on. Just short.
On middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Well played! This is full and on middle. Azam wrists it away, wide of the man at deep square leg for yet another boundary.
Very full and on off, pushed back to Tickner who makes a stop with his boot.
Length and on middle. Defended out.

Ohhh! That looked like a chance! This is short and outside off, stays low. Rizwan chops it back to the keeper. Rizwan finds himself off-guarded and Devon Conway, the keeper fumbles to collect cleanly or else there was a big chance to dislodge the bails off.
Flat, outside off. Rizwan cuts it straight to point. Much better from Michael Bracewell.
Tossed up, full and around off. Rizwan bunts it to mid-wicket.
Outside off. Rizwan keeps it out.
Flatter and outside off. Rizwan punches it to covers.
Michael Bracewell serves a rank long hop, on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Two wides! Again going down the leg side, turning more away. Rizwan misses his flick. It goes behind the keeper for a single.
Wide! This is way down the leg side. Left alone.
Michael Bracewell to bowl now.
FOUR! Azam gets a boundary now! Not a good start by New Zealand but Pakistan will take it! Another short ball on middle. Azam pulls it wide of deep square leg for a boundary.
An arm ball, this is full and angling down. Azam misses his flick.
Tad short and on middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Angling on the pads, this is flicked to square leg for one. Azam is underway as well.
This is slow and on middle. Rizwan nudges it to mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Rizwan greets Santner with a boundary! Not a good start! This is short and on middle. Rizwan pulls it behind square leg for four runs.
Mitchell Santner to bowl from the other end.
A single to end the over! Good start by Pakistan! On middle, this is hit to square leg.
FOUR! Yet another good shot! This is full and outside off, swinging away. Rizwan prods and drives it through covers, beats the fielder and it races into the fence.
FOUR! Good shot and Pakistan are underway! This is full ball, outside off. Rizwan steps across and flicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Again gets forward! This is on a length and outside off. Rizwan taps it to covers.
On a length and outside off. Rizwan leans and punches it to cover.
Swing for Southee! A length ball, outside off, moving away. Rizwan has a feel for it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
We are all set for the action. The Kiwi players are out in the middle. Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam to open for Pakistan. Tim Southee has the new ball in hand. Let's play.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Finn Allen, Devon Conway (WK), Kane Williamson (C), Glenn Phillips, Mark Chapman, James Neesham, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner (In for Adam Milne), Ish Sodhi, Tim Southee, Blair Tickner (In for Trent Boult).

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Shan Masood, Haider Ali, Iftikhar Ahmed, Asif Ali, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Nawaz, Mohammad Wasim, Naseem Shah (In for Haris Rauf), Shahnawaz Dahani.
TOSS - Pakistan have won the toss and will BAT first!

Earlier in the series when these two met, Pakistan won comfortably with Babar Azam anchoring the innings. They will look to the double. Can New Zealand get the revenge? We will find out soon. This series is more about teams getting themselves ready for the upcoming big tournament. So, both will look to put the best foot forward. Toss coming up soon.
